lens_angle: Lifecycle, derating at a 70 C bay and consignment logistics (not the BOM-to-land match of round 22); U9 alternate C3662799 and U4 alternates C26633007 / C46898862 CPL rotation from their EasyEDA footprints.

findings.title: Hot-end derating compares 85 C-rated parts with the 70 C bay air, but the records' own board-heating estimate puts the board 26-66 C above the bay at full camera and port load

records: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md line 91 (Temperature row): 'Every other fitted part is rated -40...+85 C or wider'; bay -20...+70 C, 85 C unshaded (DESIGN_ASSURANCE 6.1).

docs/M3_R10.md 'Port LDO' bullet and docs/R10_VALIDATION.md owner row 26: 'U400 and L400 lose 1.2-2.2 W and logic and SD writes 1.4-2.2 W on a board with roughly 10-15 C/W to the bay air (Inference)'. The first-article power-knot measurement thermocouples only U401, U400 and L400.
evidence.calculation: Board heat 2.6-4.4 W x 10-15 C/W = 26-66 C mean board rise (the records' own Inference inputs) -> 96-136 C board at the 70 C bay limit with the camera at 1 A and 0.56 A on PORT_4V8. Even 2 W x 10 C/W gives 90 C.
parts_rated_85C_or_less_on_power_paths: X5R (-55...+85 C, Samsung MLCC catalogue, temperature-characteristic table, code A = X5R; cached r14_parts_pdf/samsung.pdf): C6, C7 (VLOGIC, CL21A226MAQNNNE C45783), C8, C9 (3V3), C10, C11 (3V3A), C80, C96 (BAT_IN, CL31A106KBHNNNE C13585), C89, C95 (BAT_IN damper, CL31A226KAHNNNE C12891), C19, C20 (VCAP, C23630), C22, C23, C28 (VBUS), C92

U2 AP63203WU-7 (3V3 logic buck) and U400 AP63201WU-7 (PORT_5V3 buck): TA -40...+85 C, 'device function is not guaranteed outside of the recommended operating conditions' (Diodes DS41326 Rev 3-2, Recommended Operating Conditions and Note 7, p4, https://www.diodes.com/part/view/AP63203 (datasheet DS41326 Rev 3-2; repo cache r14_parts_pdf/ap6320.pdf))
Also 85 C ambient/part ratings off the power path: Y1 NX3225GA, U3 W25Q128JVSIQ, U5 MS5611, J430 microSD, LED1/LED2 (JLC listings, 2026-11-01T05:01Z); LS120 +70 C (already recorded).

findings.impact: Bounded: no pyro path depends on these parts being in rating, and the case needs the camera and full port load at the 70 C bay limit for long enough to reach steady state. But the derating record treats an 85 C rating as 15 C of margin when, by its own heating Inference, the board can sit above 85 C; X5R capacitance and the AP6320x regulation (the 3V3 logic supply included) are then outside the maker's stated range. The planned first-article thermocouple run would not show it, because it measures only U401 / U400 / L400.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. In REQUIREMENTS' Temperature row and owner row 26 / ORDERING 8.3, state that the hot-end ratings are judged against part (board) temperature, not bay air, and extend the first-article power-knot measurement to log board temperature at C6/C7 and U2, at one BAT_IN X5R (C89) and near Y1 / U3, at the 70 C allocation loads, with the pass criterion 'every 85 C-rated part <= 85 C'. If it fails, the remedy is a camera / port duty limit on the pad, or X7R parts on the same lands at the next board change.

findings.status: new (extends R22-PARTS-01, which covered franchised availability only)
findings.title: The 'consign franchised U4 / U9 to JLC' fallback does not record JLC's actual consignment process, the parts' moisture handling, the carrier or the quantity

evidence.records: docs/ORDERING.md section 8.1 (rows U4, U9 and owner choices (a)-(d)) and line 436 say 'consign franchised ... into JLC's parts inventory'; round22_alternates.md section 3 infers '1-2 weeks'. No fee, deposit, review, address, MSL or carrier rule is recorded (grep of ORDERING for consign/MSL/bake/cut tape).
evidence.jlc_process: JLC help 'How to consign parts to JLCPCB' (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-consign-parts-to-jlcpcb, read 2026-11-01T~05:00Z): parts from outside mainland China go to JLC's Hong Kong warehouse; register each part with unit price, maker, HS code, origin and unit weight plus purchase records; price review within two business days; the shipment must be approved before dispatch or it may be returned; duty + 13 % import VAT are a refundable deposit; handling fee 2 % of declared value, minimum USD 10 per shipment (non-refundable); retrieval 30 %, minimum USD 30; storage free for three years. Packaging rules are shown only in JLC's system (not public). The page states nothing on MSL handling, attrition or labels.
evidence.jlc_msl: JLC help article 123 (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/123-Moisture-Sensitivity-Level-MSL-for-Electronic-Parts): floor life MSL 2 = 1 year, MSL 3 = 168 h; no consigned-part bake rule.
evidence.u9: TPS259470LRPWR and TPS259470ARPWR: MSL Level-2-260C-1 YEAR, 3000 / LARGE T&R, Active (TI SLVSFC9C Rev C packaging addendum p68; ti.com/product/TPS25947 OPN data 2026-11-01T04:55Z; TPS259470LRPWR availability OutOfStock, TPS259470ARPWR InStock). The product page's carrier dialog lists full reel, custom reel (continuous cut tape with 18-inch leader and trailer, reeling fee) and cut tape (generic TI text, not OPN-specific), which conflicts with ORDERING's 'sold only as a 3000-piece reel'.
evidence.u4: ISM6HG256XTR: DS15034 Rev 1 section 18 p185 says only 'qualified for soldering heat resistance according to JEDEC J-STD-020'; no MSL level is stated; reel 330 mm (Table 548 p186); JLC encapsulationNumber 5000. st.com timed out, so the MSL could not be read from ST's product page (Inference: ST MEMS LGA is commonly MSL 3, which would give 168 h floor life and a bake if exceeded).

findings.impact: Procedure gap. An owner following ORDERING would meet a customs registration, a price review, a deposit and a minimum fee they were not told about, and nothing tells them to ship the LGA in a sealed moisture-barrier bag with its MSL label, or to buy attrition spares for U9 (only the old R9 line 34 gives 7-10 for U4). Added lead time is at least two business days of review plus transit (the 1-2 weeks is still an Inference).
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: add a short 'Consigning U4 / U9' paragraph to ORDERING 8.1 with the JLC steps and fees above (dated, with the URL), 'buy 7-10 of each for 5 boards', 'ship in the maker's sealed moisture-barrier bag with HIC; U9 MSL 2 (1 year); confirm U4's MSL on ST's material declaration or packing label and request JLC's bake if the floor life is exceeded', 'cut tape or a TI custom reel with leader; confirm the accepted carrier in JLC's consignment form', and correct 'sold only as a 3000-piece reel' to what the TI store actually offers on order day.

findings.impact: If the owner adopted the LSM6DSV320X or 80X by editing BOM fields only, as section 2.2 says, JLC would place a pin-1-reversed LGA (wrong pins on every land; no X-ray-free inspection). The generator path (pads.json + jlc_orient) would catch it, and ORDERING's table row says to regenerate; the defect is in the analysis text and the option (d) bullet.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: in round22_alternates.md 2.2 / 2.3 and ORDERING 8.1 option (d), add 'U4 CPL rotation becomes Bottom 0 (EasyEDA TL footprint, theta 0, residual 0.052 mm; round 23 parts lens); regenerate with r10_fab.sh and run jlc_orient --verify-cpl; for the 80X add C46898862 to tools/jlc_easyeda/pads.json first (same pads as C26633007)'. The claim '0 deg for the LSM6DSV320X' in parts_qualification.md and ORDERING's table row holds.
